root_cause.detail: The model-free Xiaomi preflight accepted a calibrated latest-session cross-provider volume difference within 0.2%, while run_hk_original_model_probe.py still required absolute native-vs-baseline volume difference <=0.5 share before setting input_validated=true. The validated Xiaomi latest-session provider difference is about 41,745 shares / 0.0254%, so the native observer rejected the input before any DeepSeek HTTP request.

next_required_action: In a new bounded run, repair only the observer input-validation contract so it consumes the already-calibrated volume reconciliation result without weakening dual-source validation; test model-free first. Because the durable claim and canonical native evidence artifact now exist, do not issue another model request until a separate reconciliation policy explicitly resolves the claimed-but-zero-HTTP-request state.
